# AI Automation with n8n

> AI Automation with n8n is a free, complete course that teaches you to design, build, debug, and run n8n workflows that do real work, from a first two-node workflow to an AI agent with tools and memory and a production instance you can defend. By TechAurah (TechAura), under the TechAurah Academy name.

Key facts:
- License: MIT. Price: free. No sign-up, no certificate; the completion artifact is a public capstone project indexed in the course showcase.
- Format: 35 numbered lessons (00 to 34) in 8 modules, each with a written lesson, an importable workflow JSON validated in CI, a Python twin or checker where the logic is testable offline, one exercise, and a worked solution.
- Stack: n8n 2.x (self-hosted Community Edition in Docker is the main path; n8n Cloud works with noted differences), Python 3.11+ standard library for twins, Ollama for local AI models.
- Zero-credential rule: every lesson runs on the free self-hosted edition with simulated steps or local models. Paid options are flagged at the top of a lesson, never midway.
- Audience: operators, founders, agency teams, and developers who can read JSON and a little JavaScript or Python.
- Capstone: the Lead Machine for a fictional dental clinic: intake, qualification, follow-up, and a daily digest, with idempotency, error handling, approvals, and a shipping gate.
